name: Trillville
notes: The research states a generator rule outright — *allow a pitched noise loop to replace the hat layer* — and this file is that rule as parameters. The percussion block carries `woodblock` and `rim` at an **offbeat** placement, density 2–4 a bar and only −2 dB, which is louder than any other perc layer in this batch; the hat block is correspondingly starved (8ths, `fillDensity` 0.30–0.45, almost no open hats). The squeak figure is the subdivision and the hats are the ornament, which is the inversion of every other crunk model. ⛔ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set because the research says the "chord" is a filtered synth stab used as percussion — there is no harmony to state, so the chord part's variety comes from `chordDurationBeats` [2, 14], three `harmonicRhythm` values and a wide `voicing.register` rather than from progressions the record does not have. The melody is "two-note synth motif or none": `motifPitchCount` 2–4 and an `emptyBarBias` of 0.34, the highest here. ⚠ `confidence` is medium and the inferred parameter is `session.bpm` — the research documents the signature loop and the label/era but says the 70–80 half-time band is taken from the lane. ⚠ The 808 is a mono root pedal with no melodic movement, which is `slideProb` 0.01 and a narrow low register; "drop-outs remove the 808 and keep the squeak/clap layer" is an arrangement gesture with no parameter, so it lives only in this note. ⚠ Fill fingerprint for this batch: `gapProb` 0.48 / `descendProb` 0.58 / `rampJitter` 12. ⚠ **A register here spanned less than an octave and has been widened.** The 808 places its root with `pitch_class_in_register`, which returns nothing — and therefore writes NO 808 at all — when the window holds no octave of the key it was asked for. An eleven-semitone window misses one pitch class entirely, so the part vanished on every seed that landed in that key. The centre of the authored range is unchanged. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 774 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: styles 3, densityRatio 0.5, melody density [1,5]. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 906/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,5] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 895/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.34 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 895/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
